description: Header file defining the Windows-specific implementation of DHCP PAC file fetching, including class declarations, methods, and internal state management for DHCP-based proxy configuration retrieval.

classes.name: DhcpPacFileFetcherWin
classes.description: Windows-specific DHCP PAC file fetcher implementing the DhcpPacFileFetcher interface, managing DHCP adapter queries and PAC URL fetching.

classes.name: AdapterQuery
classes.description: Inner class handling adapter name queries on a worker thread, with methods to retrieve DHCP adapter names and logging info.

methods.name: Fetch
methods.description: Initiates fetching of PAC file via DHCP, with callback and logging.

methods.name: GetFetcherName
methods.description: Returns the name of the fetcher.

methods.name: GetCandidateAdapterNames
methods.description: Static method to retrieve DHCP-enabled adapter names, optionally logging info.

methods.name: num_pending_fetchers
methods.description: Returns the number of fetchers still pending.

methods.name: GetTaskRunner
methods.description: Returns the task runner used for DHCP lookup tasks.

methods.name: AdapterQuery
methods.description: Class encapsulating DHCP adapter name query logic on a worker thread.

methods.name: ImplCreateAdapterFetcher
methods.description: Virtual method to create adapter fetcher instances, for testing or extension.

methods.name: ImplCreateAdapterQuery
methods.description: Virtual method to create AdapterQuery instances.

methods.name: ImplGetMaxWait
methods.description: Virtual method to get maximum wait time for DHCP queries.

methods.name: ImplOnGetCandidateAdapterNamesDone
methods.description: Virtual hook called after adapter name query completion.

methods.name: OnGetCandidateAdapterNamesDone
methods.description: Handles completion of adapter name query.

methods.name: TransitionToDone
methods.description: Transitions the state machine to DONE.
